sampling.engine: rjags/JAGS for both, same installed versions and machine
sampling.geography: intercept-only, full six observation-specific effects, no geographic predictors

initialization.class: Z=1 for every precinct in every chain to provide a valid starting state; no claim this explores all posterior modes
initialization.magnitude_alphas: all four equal the chain-specific value [-1,0,1,-0.5]
initialization.A_auxiliary_counts: floor(N*mu) using the respective incremental k*logistic or extreme k+(1-k)*logistic transform, with original endpoint transformation untouched

sampling.timing: One four-chain rjags object; A then D and diagnostics sequential; avoid compilation/other sampling during measured processes. Record overlap if accidental; no automatic resampling.
sampling.failures: save error/warnings/stage/inputs/seed/log; no changed model, dropped chain, replacement seed, data exclusion, retry or extension; other independent tasks can finish
sampling.execution: One rjags object with four chains per model; A then D, sequentially; external per-model wall-clock timeout
